newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION - UNIVERSITY PLAYER DIES FROM MATCH INJURIES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - UNIVERSITY PLAYER DIES FROM MATCH INJURIES.

text.p: South African-born Ian Tucker has died in hospital after suffering a head injury playing rugby for Oxford University, a hospital spokeswoman said on Monday.
Tucker suffered concussion on Saturday night after sustaining the injury attempting a try-saving tackle against first division Saracens.
A spokeswoman at London's National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery said: "Sadly Mr Tucker continued to deteriorate and died yesterday evening at 7.15."
The 23-year-old student had been tipped to win a place in Oxford's team in their big match against Cambridge on December 10, having impressed officials after arriving from Sydney University.
